create_SegmentContextGlueCubesData: create a SegmentContextGlueCubesData dataset with configurable context and segment side lengths for voxel model training
run_glue_cubes: run glue_cubes to generate paired context and segment sparse voxel cubes along a given dimension and direction
run_directional_glue_cubes: run directional_glue_cubes to generate context and segment sparse cubes with a random viewer direction vector
create_get_sparse_cube_context_seg: create sparse context and segment cube representations from a given cube size and origin coordinates
run_autogen_dataset_cli: run the autogen_dataset CLI module to visualize generated glue cubes with optional direction and ground type
